cn_company_offerings.title: Accepted work
cn_company_offerings.statement: TCR takes bathroom remodels, kitchen remodels, and home additions (single- and multi-story). Ground-up new construction is a hard no; commercial or exterior-only work is evaluated case-by-case.

cn_company_change_orders.title: Change orders
cn_company_change_orders.statement: Change orders are written, signed, and paid in full before the associated work begins.

cn_company_deposit_gates.title: Deposit gates
cn_company_deposit_gates.statement: Demo never begins without the signed contract in hand and the 25% deposit received; payment runs 25% at contract, 25% at demo start, 25% at rough-in inspection, 25% at completion.

cn_company_fixed_price_only.title: Fixed-price contracts only
cn_company_fixed_price_only.statement: Fixed-price contracts exclusively; time-and-materials is never used for residential work.

cn_company_friday_punchlist.title: Friday punch-list
cn_company_friday_punchlist.statement: Fridays are punch-list days, not new demo starts.

cn_company_interior_concurrency.title: Interior trade concurrency
cn_company_interior_concurrency.statement: No more than two trades work concurrently inside the building; exterior trades carry no such limit.

cn_company_job_photos.title: Job photo documentation
cn_company_job_photos.statement: Before, during, and after photos are captured into every job's inputs folder.

cn_company_local_pricing.title: Local pricing confirmation
cn_company_local_pricing.statement: Allowance pricing from national-average retail data must be confirmed against local Tri-Cities supplier pricing before any order is placed.

cn_company_margin_floor.title: Margin floor
cn_company_margin_floor.statement: Gross margin floor is 30%; below that, walk.

cn_company_min_job_floor.title: Minimum job size
cn_company_min_job_floor.statement: Minimum job size is $15,000; smaller leads are referred out.

cn_company_monday_updates.title: Monday customer updates
cn_company_monday_updates.statement: Every active customer gets a weekly Monday update.

cn_company_never_split_framing.title: Never split framing
cn_company_never_split_framing.statement: Framing is never split between a sub and the in-house crew.

cn_company_no_demo_without_materials.title: No demo without materials
cn_company_no_demo_without_materials.statement: Never demo without the next phase's materials on site, and never schedule a job before the customer's final material selections are made.

cn_company_permits_always.title: Permits always
cn_company_permits_always.statement: Permits are pulled on every applicable job; skipping permits to save time is never acceptable.

cn_company_pricing_presentation.title: Pricing presentation
cn_company_pricing_presentation.statement: Materials are billed at cost plus 15% markup, itemized in estimates; labor is never itemized to shopping customers — total-vs-total only. Discounts are rare; prefer scope reduction over price cuts.

cn_company_rock_excluded.title: Rock excavation excluded
cn_company_rock_excluded.statement: Rock excavation is always excluded from base scope; encountering rock becomes a change order, never absorbed.

cn_company_kerdi_wedi.title: Shower waterproofing
cn_company_kerdi_wedi.statement: Kerdi or Wedi waterproofing membrane goes behind every tiled shower — non-negotiable.

cn_company_warranty.title: Warranty terms
cn_company_warranty.statement: Labor is warranted 1 year post-completion; materials are covered per manufacturer warranty.

cn_company_weather_window.title: Winter weather window
cn_company_weather_window.statement: Foundation and framing are not scheduled between mid-December and mid-February; every outdoor-touching phase carries a 20% timeline buffer.

cn_company_staffing_split.title: Hybrid staffing split
cn_company_staffing_split.condition: Unless job specifics or crew capacity dictate otherwise
cn_company_staffing_split.assume: The in-house crew handles anything the customer will see every day for 20 years — framing, drywall, tile, carpentry, finish — while subs handle licensed trades (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), demo, cabinet install, countertops, glass, and larger paint scopes

cn_company_sub_threshold.title: In-house vs sub threshold
cn_company_sub_threshold.condition: Unless the work is licensed-trade or the never-split-framing policy applies
cn_company_sub_threshold.assume: If the in-house crew can do it in a day, use them; if it would take 3+ days, sub it
